newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf grain and soybean values were steady on Tuesday and export sources reported no trades ahead of the New Year's holiday.
"There's not a thing going on," one source said. "Prices are nominally unchanged but there really isn't a market."
In export news, Pakistan will tender next month for 270,000 tonnes U.S. and/or Australian wheat, exporters said.
Offices will be closed Wednesday in observance of the New Year's Day holiday.
